purpose: Bind the generated facade sill-drainage assembly to one formal reflection-probe epoch across request, polling, completion and pre-still review, including Unity script/assembly reload boundaries. A genuinely missing fallback sill pass may be prepared before the first baseline; after arming, SessionState persists the epoch and a scene-object GlobalObjectId plus scene GUID freeze identity. All later checks are read-only and fail closed on replacement/deletion, authored/fallback changes, legacy-sill re-enablement, or structural/material/LOD/topology drift. This contract awards no Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: This binding proves reflection-epoch coherence only; it does not prove that the reconstructed sill dimensions are visually correct at benchmark distance.
Read-only post-arm validation cannot prove that drain openings read as physical recesses rather than overly dark holes in final pixels.
Stable GlobalObjectId and passing structural QA cannot prove that anodized-aluminum Fresnel response, highlight width or contact shadowing are filmic under the actual midsummer lighting state.

SessionState intentionally persists until the Unity Editor process exits; a new formal epoch after source/scene edits should start from a clean Editor session rather than weakening the armed epoch in place.
A newly generated but unsaved root may not have a stable GlobalObjectId and must fail closed until the benchmark scene is persisted.
The binding cannot clear visible_lod_pop or severe_aliasing_or_shimmer; native-4K temporal evidence remains mandatory.
Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime behavior remains unverified until a real Runner executes reflection request, poll, completion, an assembly reload boundary, and pre-still validation.
